prompt_text:
Task: OCR and Layout Extraction

Write code that extracts blocks, lines, tables, or layout elements from a document using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Document AI:
  Service: Google Document AI
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/overview

Option 2 — Azure Document Intelligence:
  Service: Azure AI Document Intelligence
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/overview

Option 3 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Document OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, enqueue_and_parse
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 4 — Amazon Textract:
  Service: Amazon Textract
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_document_text, analyze_document
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 5 — Alibaba Cloud OCR:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeGeneral, RecognizeAdvanced
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import io
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_document_layout(file_content: bytes, mime_type: str):
<GAP>
    project_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    location = "us"  # Or your preferred region, e.g., "us"
    processor_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID") # e.g., "YOUR_PROCESSOR_ID"

    if not all([project_id, processor_id]):
        raise ValueError("Environment variables GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID must be set.")

    # You might need to create a processor in the Google Cloud Console.
    # For general OCR and layout, a "FORM_PARSER" or "OCR_PROCESSOR" is suitable.
    # processor_name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"
    # Use documentai.CommonProcessorInfo to construct the processor path
    processor_name = documentai.CommonProcessorInfo.from_dict({
        "project": project_id,
        "location": location,
        "processor": processor_id
    }).processor_path

    document = documentai.Document(content=file_content, mime_type=mime_type)

    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(
        name=processor_name,
        document=document
    )

    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    result = client.process_document(request=request)

    document_response = result.document

    # Extracting basic layout elements: text, pages, paragraphs, lines, tokens, tables, form fields
    extracted_data = {
        "text": document_response.text,
        "pages": []
    }

    for page in document_response.pages:
        page_data = {
            "page_number": page.page_number,
            "dimension": {"width": page.dimension.width, "height": page.dimension.height, "unit": page.dimension.unit},
            "paragraphs": [],
            "lines": [],
            "tokens": [],
            "tables": [],
            "form_fields": []
        }

        for paragraph in page.paragraphs:
            page_data["paragraphs"].append(
                document_response.text[paragraph.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                      paragraph.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
            )

        for line in page.lines:
            page_data["lines"].append(
                document_response.text[line.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                      line.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
            )

        for token in page.tokens:
            page_data["tokens"].append(
                document_response.text[token.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                      token.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
            )

        for table in page.tables:
            table_data = {
                "num_rows": table.num_rows,
                "num_columns": table.num_columns,
                "header_rows": [],
                "body_rows": []
            }
            for row in table.header_rows:
                header_cells = []
                for cell in row.cells:
                    header_cells.append(
                        document_response.text[cell.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                              cell.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
                    )
                table_data["header_rows"].append(header_cells)
            for row in table.body_rows:
                body_cells = []
                for cell in row.cells:
                    body_cells.append(
                        document_response.text[cell.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                              cell.layout.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
                    )
                table_data["body_rows"].append(body_cells)
            page_data["tables"].append(table_data)

        for form_field in page.form_fields:
            field_name = document_response.text[form_field.field_name.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                                form_field.field_name.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
            field_value = document_response.text[form_field.field_value.text_anchor.text_segments[0].start_index:
                                                 form_field.field_value.text_anchor.text_segments[0].end_index]
            page_data["form_fields"].append({"name": field_name, "value": field_value})


        extracted_data["pages"].append(page_data)

    return extracted_data
